statement: Both owner-window-created virtual Wii devices retain hid-generic after ignore_special_drivers is restored to 0. Before and after the bounded native Dolphin arms, each exact HID root has zero input companions and libxwiimote iface creation returns -19 (ENODEV). Kernel evdev MotionPlus axes and xwiimote access are absent in this binding. This is a test/dev host trade-off, not a physical or release qualification.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revisions unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. provenance_class: compat. Generic-bound W9e retry; earlier #55 failed bind remains historical. Test/dev host precondition only; release gate virtualgamepad #258. No physical/radio/rate/game/challenge claim.
